references.text: The same theme about the leaders in Israel who volunteered themselves, and the people blessing the Lord
Reference to princes and leaders (חוקקים) who dig wells, using the same Hebrew word for lawmakers/leaders
Uses the same word for lawgiver (מחקק), referring to leadership in Israel
The people who voluntarily give (מתנדבים) to the Lord's work, the same theme of voluntariness
David praises God for the people's voluntary gifts, parallel to blessing the Lord for their willingness
Reference to the princes and leaders of Israel gathering to praise God
The people will be willing (נדבת) on the Lord's day, the same theme of voluntariness
The people bless those who voluntarily dwell in Jerusalem, combining voluntariness and blessing
